findings.title: Exactly one H1
findings.fix: Use exactly one <h1> as the page's main heading. Demote the extras to <h2> or below.

findings.title: H1 length
findings.fix: Rewrite the H1 to sit between 10 and 70 characters. One word says nothing; a sentence is not a heading.

findings.title: Canonical URL present
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing to the preferred absolute URL of this page.

findings.title: Charset declared
findings.fix: Add <meta charset="utf-8"> as the first tag in <head>.

findings.title: Viewport meta present
findings.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> for mobile rendering.

findings.title: Page is indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the robots meta tag if this page should appear in search.

findings.title: Open Graph basics
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image meta tags so the page previews well when shared.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy
findings.fix: Order headings without skipping levels. Do not jump from H2 straight to H4.

findings.title: Word count
findings.fix: Add more substantive content. Thin pages rank poorly. Aim for at least 300 meaningful words.

findings.title: No empty headings
findings.fix: Remove empty heading tags or give them real text.

findings.title: Keyword stuffing
findings.fix: Reduce the repetition of the flagged word and write naturally.

findings.title: Text to HTML ratio
findings.fix: Increase real text relative to markup, or trim bloated HTML.

findings.title: HTML lang attribute
findings.fix: Set the language on the root element, e.g. <html lang="en">.

findings.title: Broken internal links
findings.fix: Fix or remove the linked internal URLs that return errors.

findings.title: Broken external links
findings.fix: Update or remove external links that no longer resolve.

findings.title: Redirect chains
findings.fix: Point the link straight at the final URL so the page loads in one hop.

findings.title: Weak anchor text
findings.fix: Replace generic anchors like 'click here' with text that describes the destination.

findings.title: External link rel
findings.fix: Add rel="noopener" (and noreferrer) to external links, especially those opening new tabs.

findings.title: Image alt text
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image. Use alt="" only for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Image dimensions
findings.fix: Set width and height attributes on images to prevent layout shift.

findings.title: Modern image formats
findings.fix: Serve images as WebP or AVIF for smaller files and faster loads.

findings.title: Lazy loading
findings.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the fold.

findings.title: Image filenames
findings.fix: Rename images to descriptive, keyword-relevant filenames instead of IMG_1234.jpg.

findings.title: Image src present
findings.fix: Give every a valid src, or remove the tag.

findings.title: Organization or WebSite schema
findings.fix: Add Organization or WebSite JSON-LD so search engines understand the site entity and can show a knowledge panel.

findings.title: JSON-LD @context
findings.fix: Each JSON-LD block should declare "@context": "https://schema.org".

findings.title: Organization sameAs links
findings.fix: Add a sameAs array to your Organization schema linking to your official social and profile URLs. It strengthens entity recognition.

findings.title: Organization logo
findings.fix: Add a logo property to your Organization schema so Google can use it in search features.

findings.title: Article required fields
findings.fix: Article schema needs headline, image, datePublished, and author for rich results. Add the missing fields.

findings.title: Article schema has image
findings.fix: Article and NewsArticle schema should include an image property for rich results.

findings.title: JSON-LD present
findings.fix: Add JSON-LD structured data describing the page, e.g. Article, Product, or Organization.

findings.title: JSON-LD parses
findings.fix: Fix the JSON syntax in the flagged ld+json blocks so they parse cleanly.

findings.title: JSON-LD has @type
findings.fix: Include an @type in each JSON-LD block so search engines know what it describes.

findings.title: Breadcrumb schema
findings.fix: Add BreadcrumbList structured data to show the page's position in the site.

findings.title: Duplicate JSON-LD types
findings.fix: Merge or remove duplicate schema blocks of the same @type.

findings.message: Server header does not leak a version
findings.title: Server header disclosure
findings.fix: Remove or genericise the Server header so it does not reveal software and version.

findings.title: X-Powered-By disclosure
findings.fix: Remove the X-Powered-By header. It discloses your stack and helps attackers.

findings.message: No cookies set on this response
findings.title: Secure cookies
findings.fix: Set Secure and HttpOnly on cookies so they are not sent over HTTP or read by scripts.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
findings.fix: Add Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin to isolate your browsing context.

findings.title: Served over HTTPS
findings.fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

findings.title: HSTS header
findings.fix: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS on future visits.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header to limit what scripts and resources can load.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection
findings.fix: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or a CSP frame-ancestors directive to block clickjacking.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.fix: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to stop MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Referrer-Policy header, e.g. strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Mixed content
findings.fix: Load every resource over HTTPS. Replace any http:// references with https://.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict powerful browser features the site does not use.

findings.title: robots.txt exists
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt at the site root to guide crawlers.

findings.title: robots.txt valid
findings.fix: Add valid directives (User-agent, Disallow, Allow, Sitemap) to robots.txt.

findings.title: Sitemap present
findings.fix: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.title: Page indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the page meta or its X-Robots-Tag header if it should be indexed.

findings.title: Canonical valid
findings.fix: Use an absolute, valid URL in the canonical link.

findings.title: X-Robots-Tag header
findings.fix: Remove noindex or nofollow from the X-Robots-Tag header if the page should rank.

findings.title: Lowercase URL
findings.fix: Use lowercase URLs. Mixed case creates duplicate-URL issues because servers often treat cases differently.

findings.title: Hyphens not underscores
findings.fix: Separate words with hyphens, not underscores. Google treats hyphens as word separators and underscores as joiners.

findings.title: No spaces in URL
findings.fix: Remove spaces from URLs. Replace them with hyphens. Encoded spaces (%20) are hard to read and share.

findings.message: URL uses ASCII or encoded characters
findings.title: ASCII or encoded characters
findings.fix: Percent-encode non-ASCII characters in URLs so every client handles them the same way.

findings.title: Few query parameters
findings.fix: Minimise query parameters. Many parameters multiply crawlable URLs and dilute ranking signals. Aim for two or fewer.

findings.title: Readable, word-based path
findings.fix: Use descriptive words in URLs instead of bare IDs. /products/leather-wallet beats /p?id=42.

findings.title: URL length
findings.fix: Keep URLs short. Long URLs are harder to share and can be truncated in search results. Aim under 100 characters.

findings.title: Shallow path depth
findings.fix: Avoid deep nesting. Keep important pages within a few clicks of the root. Aim for four path segments or fewer.

findings.title: Twitter Card
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> so links preview well on X/Twitter.

findings.title: Open Graph image is absolute
findings.fix: og:image must be an absolute https URL. Social platforms cannot resolve relative paths.

findings.message: og:url or canonical absent, nothing to compare
findings.title: og:url matches canonical
findings.fix: Set og:url to the page's canonical URL so shares consolidate to one address.

findings.title: Social profile links
findings.fix: Link to your social profiles so visitors and search engines can connect your brand accounts.

findings.message: No hreflang alternates (fine for a single-language site)
findings.title: hreflang annotations
findings.fix: If the site serves more than one language or region, add hreflang link alternates so Google serves the right version.

findings.title: hreflang values valid
findings.fix: Use valid hreflang values: a language code, language-REGION (en-US), or x-default. Include a self-referencing and an x-default tag.

findings.title: Privacy policy link
findings.fix: Link to a privacy policy. Most jurisdictions require one if you collect any personal data.

findings.message: No terms of service link found
findings.title: Terms of service link
findings.fix: Link to terms of service or terms and conditions to set the rules for using your site.

findings.title: Cookie consent
findings.fix: If you set non-essential cookies, show a consent banner (a CMP) to comply with privacy law.

findings.title: Contact information
findings.fix: Provide a contact link or page. It builds trust and is a positive E-E-A-T signal.

findings.title: Analytics installed
findings.fix: Install an analytics tag (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, etc.) so you can measure traffic and behaviour.

findings.message: No Google tag, consent mode not required
findings.title: Consent mode
findings.fix: If you use Google tags in regulated regions, configure Consent Mode so tracking respects user consent.

findings.title: Author attribution
findings.fix: Attribute content to a named author via a byline, rel=author, or schema author property.

findings.message: No published or updated date found
findings.title: Published or updated date
findings.fix: Show a published or last-updated date. Freshness and transparency are trust signals.

findings.title: Outbound citations
findings.fix: Cite authoritative external sources. Outbound links to reputable sites support your claims.

findings.title: About page
findings.fix: Link to an about page that explains who is behind the site. It is a core trust signal.

findings.title: Render-blocking scripts
findings.fix: Add defer or async to scripts in <head>, or move them before </body>, so they do not block rendering.

findings.title: Stylesheet count
findings.fix: Combine stylesheets. Many separate CSS files add round trips. Aim for a handful.

findings.title: Inline script size
findings.fix: Move large inline scripts to cacheable external files.

findings.title: Text compression
findings.fix: Enable gzip or Brotli compression on HTML, CSS, and JS responses to cut transfer size.

findings.title: Cache headers
findings.fix: Send a Cache-Control header so browsers and CDNs can cache responses.

findings.title: HTML document size
findings.fix: Reduce the raw HTML size. Large documents are slow to parse. Aim under 100KB.

findings.message: Server header does not leak a version
findings.title: Server header disclosure
findings.fix: Remove or genericise the Server header so it does not reveal software and version.

findings.title: X-Powered-By disclosure
findings.fix: Remove the X-Powered-By header. It discloses your stack and helps attackers.

findings.message: No cookies set on this response
findings.title: Secure cookies
findings.fix: Set Secure and HttpOnly on cookies so they are not sent over HTTP or read by scripts.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
findings.fix: Add Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin to isolate your browsing context.

findings.title: Served over HTTPS
findings.fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

findings.title: HSTS header
findings.fix: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS on future visits.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header to limit what scripts and resources can load.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection
findings.fix: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or a CSP frame-ancestors directive to block clickjacking.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.fix: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to stop MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Referrer-Policy header, e.g. strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Mixed content
findings.fix: Load every resource over HTTPS. Replace any http:// references with https://.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict powerful browser features the site does not use.

findings.title: robots.txt exists
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt at the site root to guide crawlers.

findings.title: robots.txt valid
findings.fix: Add valid directives (User-agent, Disallow, Allow, Sitemap) to robots.txt.

findings.title: Sitemap present
findings.fix: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.title: Page indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the page meta or its X-Robots-Tag header if it should be indexed.

findings.title: Canonical valid
findings.fix: Use an absolute, valid URL in the canonical link.

findings.title: X-Robots-Tag header
findings.fix: Remove noindex or nofollow from the X-Robots-Tag header if the page should rank.

findings.title: Lowercase URL
findings.fix: Use lowercase URLs. Mixed case creates duplicate-URL issues because servers often treat cases differently.

findings.title: Hyphens not underscores
findings.fix: Separate words with hyphens, not underscores. Google treats hyphens as word separators and underscores as joiners.

findings.title: No spaces in URL
findings.fix: Remove spaces from URLs. Replace them with hyphens. Encoded spaces (%20) are hard to read and share.

findings.message: URL uses ASCII or encoded characters
findings.title: ASCII or encoded characters
findings.fix: Percent-encode non-ASCII characters in URLs so every client handles them the same way.

findings.title: Few query parameters
findings.fix: Minimise query parameters. Many parameters multiply crawlable URLs and dilute ranking signals. Aim for two or fewer.

findings.title: Readable, word-based path
findings.fix: Use descriptive words in URLs instead of bare IDs. /products/leather-wallet beats /p?id=42.

findings.title: URL length
findings.fix: Keep URLs short. Long URLs are harder to share and can be truncated in search results. Aim under 100 characters.

findings.title: Shallow path depth
findings.fix: Avoid deep nesting. Keep important pages within a few clicks of the root. Aim for four path segments or fewer.

findings.title: Twitter Card
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> so links preview well on X/Twitter.

findings.title: Open Graph image is absolute
findings.fix: og:image must be an absolute https URL. Social platforms cannot resolve relative paths.

findings.message: og:url or canonical absent, nothing to compare
findings.title: og:url matches canonical
findings.fix: Set og:url to the page's canonical URL so shares consolidate to one address.

findings.title: Social profile links
findings.fix: Link to your social profiles so visitors and search engines can connect your brand accounts.

findings.message: No hreflang alternates (fine for a single-language site)
findings.title: hreflang annotations
findings.fix: If the site serves more than one language or region, add hreflang link alternates so Google serves the right version.

findings.title: hreflang values valid
findings.fix: Use valid hreflang values: a language code, language-REGION (en-US), or x-default. Include a self-referencing and an x-default tag.

findings.title: Privacy policy link
findings.fix: Link to a privacy policy. Most jurisdictions require one if you collect any personal data.

findings.message: No terms of service link found
findings.title: Terms of service link
findings.fix: Link to terms of service or terms and conditions to set the rules for using your site.

findings.title: Cookie consent
findings.fix: If you set non-essential cookies, show a consent banner (a CMP) to comply with privacy law.

findings.title: Contact information
findings.fix: Provide a contact link or page. It builds trust and is a positive E-E-A-T signal.

findings.title: Analytics installed
findings.fix: Install an analytics tag (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, etc.) so you can measure traffic and behaviour.

findings.message: No Google tag, consent mode not required
findings.title: Consent mode
findings.fix: If you use Google tags in regulated regions, configure Consent Mode so tracking respects user consent.

findings.title: Author attribution
findings.fix: Attribute content to a named author via a byline, rel=author, or schema author property.

findings.message: No published or updated date found
findings.title: Published or updated date
findings.fix: Show a published or last-updated date. Freshness and transparency are trust signals.

findings.title: Outbound citations
findings.fix: Cite authoritative external sources. Outbound links to reputable sites support your claims.

findings.title: About page
findings.fix: Link to an about page that explains who is behind the site. It is a core trust signal.

findings.title: Render-blocking scripts
findings.fix: Add defer or async to scripts in <head>, or move them before </body>, so they do not block rendering.

findings.title: Stylesheet count
findings.fix: Combine stylesheets. Many separate CSS files add round trips. Aim for a handful.

findings.title: Inline script size
findings.fix: Move large inline scripts to cacheable external files.

findings.title: Text compression
findings.fix: Enable gzip or Brotli compression on HTML, CSS, and JS responses to cut transfer size.

findings.title: Cache headers
findings.fix: Send a Cache-Control header so browsers and CDNs can cache responses.

findings.title: HTML document size
findings.fix: Reduce the raw HTML size. Large documents are slow to parse. Aim under 100KB.

findings.fix: Add a unique <title> in <head> that summarises the page in 30 to 60 characters.

findings.title: Title length
findings.fix: Rewrite the title to sit between 30 and 60 characters so it is not truncated in search results.

findings.title: Meta description present
findings.fix: Add a <meta name="description"> with a 70 to 160 character summary of the page.

findings.title: Meta description length
findings.fix: Trim or expand the meta description to 70 to 160 characters.

findings.title: Exactly one H1
findings.fix: Use exactly one <h1> as the page's main heading. Demote the extras to <h2> or below.

findings.title: H1 length
findings.fix: Rewrite the H1 to sit between 10 and 70 characters. One word says nothing; a sentence is not a heading.

findings.title: Canonical URL present
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing to the preferred absolute URL of this page.

findings.fix: Add <meta charset="utf-8"> as the first tag in <head>.

findings.title: Viewport meta present
findings.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> for mobile rendering.

findings.title: Page is indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the robots meta tag if this page should appear in search.

findings.title: Open Graph basics
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image meta tags so the page previews well when shared.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy
findings.fix: Order headings without skipping levels. Do not jump from H2 straight to H4.

findings.title: Word count
findings.fix: Add more substantive content. Thin pages rank poorly. Aim for at least 300 meaningful words.

findings.title: No empty headings
findings.fix: Remove empty heading tags or give them real text.

findings.title: Keyword stuffing
findings.fix: Reduce the repetition of the flagged word and write naturally.

findings.title: Text to HTML ratio
findings.fix: Increase real text relative to markup, or trim bloated HTML.

findings.title: HTML lang attribute
findings.fix: Set the language on the root element, e.g. <html lang="en">.

findings.title: Broken internal links
findings.fix: Fix or remove the linked internal URLs that return errors.

findings.title: Broken external links
findings.fix: Update or remove external links that no longer resolve.

findings.title: Redirect chains
findings.fix: Point the link straight at the final URL so the page loads in one hop.

findings.title: Weak anchor text
findings.fix: Replace generic anchors like 'click here' with text that describes the destination.

findings.title: External link rel
findings.fix: Add rel="noopener" (and noreferrer) to external links, especially those opening new tabs.

findings.title: Image alt text
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image. Use alt="" only for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Image dimensions
findings.fix: Set width and height attributes on images to prevent layout shift.

findings.title: Modern image formats
findings.fix: Serve images as WebP or AVIF for smaller files and faster loads.

findings.title: Lazy loading
findings.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the fold.

findings.title: Image filenames
findings.fix: Rename images to descriptive, keyword-relevant filenames instead of IMG_1234.jpg.

findings.title: Image src present
findings.fix: Give every a valid src, or remove the tag.

findings.title: Page is indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the robots meta tag if this page should appear in search.

findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image meta tags so the page previews well when shared.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy
findings.fix: Order headings without skipping levels. Do not jump from H2 straight to H4.

findings.title: Word count
findings.fix: Add more substantive content. Thin pages rank poorly. Aim for at least 300 meaningful words.

findings.title: No empty headings
findings.fix: Remove empty heading tags or give them real text.

findings.title: Keyword stuffing
findings.fix: Reduce the repetition of the flagged word and write naturally.

findings.title: Text to HTML ratio
findings.fix: Increase real text relative to markup, or trim bloated HTML.

findings.title: HTML lang attribute
findings.fix: Set the language on the root element, e.g. <html lang="en">.

findings.title: Broken internal links
findings.fix: Fix or remove the linked internal URLs that return errors.

findings.title: Broken external links
findings.fix: Update or remove external links that no longer resolve.

findings.title: Redirect chains
findings.fix: Point the link straight at the final URL so the page loads in one hop.

findings.title: Weak anchor text
findings.fix: Replace generic anchors like 'click here' with text that describes the destination.

findings.message: External links have safe rel attributes
findings.title: External link rel
findings.fix: Add rel="noopener" (and noreferrer) to external links, especially those opening new tabs.

findings.title: Image alt text
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image. Use alt="" only for purely decorative images.

findings.message: All images have width and height
findings.title: Image dimensions
findings.fix: Set width and height attributes on images to prevent layout shift.

findings.title: Modern image formats
findings.fix: Serve images as WebP or AVIF for smaller files and faster loads.

findings.message: Too few images to need lazy loading
findings.title: Lazy loading
findings.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the fold.

findings.title: Image filenames
findings.fix: Rename images to descriptive, keyword-relevant filenames instead of IMG_1234.jpg.

findings.title: Image src present
findings.fix: Give every a valid src, or remove the tag.

findings.title: Organization or WebSite schema
findings.fix: Add Organization or WebSite JSON-LD so search engines understand the site entity and can show a knowledge panel.

findings.title: JSON-LD @context
findings.fix: Each JSON-LD block should declare "@context": "https://schema.org".

findings.title: Organization sameAs links
findings.fix: Add a sameAs array to your Organization schema linking to your official social and profile URLs. It strengthens entity recognition.

findings.title: Organization logo
findings.fix: Add a logo property to your Organization schema so Google can use it in search features.

findings.title: Article required fields
findings.fix: Article schema needs headline, image, datePublished, and author for rich results. Add the missing fields.

findings.title: Article schema has image
findings.fix: Article and NewsArticle schema should include an image property for rich results.

findings.title: JSON-LD present
findings.fix: Add JSON-LD structured data describing the page, e.g. Article, Product, or Organization.

findings.title: JSON-LD parses
findings.fix: Fix the JSON syntax in the flagged ld+json blocks so they parse cleanly.

findings.title: JSON-LD has @type
findings.fix: Include an @type in each JSON-LD block so search engines know what it describes.

findings.title: Breadcrumb schema
findings.fix: Add BreadcrumbList structured data to show the page's position in the site.

findings.title: Duplicate JSON-LD types
findings.fix: Merge or remove duplicate schema blocks of the same @type.

findings.message: Server header does not leak a version
findings.title: Server header disclosure
findings.fix: Remove or genericise the Server header so it does not reveal software and version.

findings.title: X-Powered-By disclosure
findings.fix: Remove the X-Powered-By header. It discloses your stack and helps attackers.

findings.message: No cookies set on this response
findings.title: Secure cookies
findings.fix: Set Secure and HttpOnly on cookies so they are not sent over HTTP or read by scripts.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
findings.fix: Add Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin to isolate your browsing context.

findings.title: Served over HTTPS
findings.fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

findings.title: HSTS header
findings.fix: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS on future visits.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header to limit what scripts and resources can load.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection
findings.fix: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or a CSP frame-ancestors directive to block clickjacking.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.fix: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to stop MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Referrer-Policy header, e.g. strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Mixed content
findings.fix: Load every resource over HTTPS. Replace any http:// references with https://.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict powerful browser features the site does not use.

findings.title: robots.txt exists
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt at the site root to guide crawlers.

findings.title: robots.txt valid
findings.fix: Add valid directives (User-agent, Disallow, Allow, Sitemap) to robots.txt.

findings.title: Sitemap present
findings.fix: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.title: Page indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the page meta or its X-Robots-Tag header if it should be indexed.

findings.title: Canonical valid
findings.fix: Use an absolute, valid URL in the canonical link.

findings.title: X-Robots-Tag header
findings.fix: Remove noindex or nofollow from the X-Robots-Tag header if the page should rank.

findings.title: Lowercase URL
findings.fix: Use lowercase URLs. Mixed case creates duplicate-URL issues because servers often treat cases differently.

findings.title: Hyphens not underscores
findings.fix: Separate words with hyphens, not underscores. Google treats hyphens as word separators and underscores as joiners.

findings.title: No spaces in URL
findings.fix: Remove spaces from URLs. Replace them with hyphens. Encoded spaces (%20) are hard to read and share.

findings.message: URL uses ASCII or encoded characters
findings.title: ASCII or encoded characters
findings.fix: Percent-encode non-ASCII characters in URLs so every client handles them the same way.

findings.title: Few query parameters
findings.fix: Minimise query parameters. Many parameters multiply crawlable URLs and dilute ranking signals. Aim for two or fewer.

findings.title: Readable, word-based path
findings.fix: Use descriptive words in URLs instead of bare IDs. /products/leather-wallet beats /p?id=42.

findings.title: URL length
findings.fix: Keep URLs short. Long URLs are harder to share and can be truncated in search results. Aim under 100 characters.

findings.title: Shallow path depth
findings.fix: Avoid deep nesting. Keep important pages within a few clicks of the root. Aim for four path segments or fewer.

findings.title: Twitter Card
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> so links preview well on X/Twitter.

findings.title: Open Graph image is absolute
findings.fix: og:image must be an absolute https URL. Social platforms cannot resolve relative paths.

findings.message: og:url or canonical absent, nothing to compare
findings.title: og:url matches canonical
findings.fix: Set og:url to the page's canonical URL so shares consolidate to one address.

findings.title: Social profile links
findings.fix: Link to your social profiles so visitors and search engines can connect your brand accounts.

findings.message: No hreflang alternates (fine for a single-language site)
findings.title: hreflang annotations
findings.fix: If the site serves more than one language or region, add hreflang link alternates so Google serves the right version.

findings.title: hreflang values valid
findings.fix: Use valid hreflang values: a language code, language-REGION (en-US), or x-default. Include a self-referencing and an x-default tag.

findings.title: Privacy policy link
findings.fix: Link to a privacy policy. Most jurisdictions require one if you collect any personal data.

findings.message: No terms of service link found
findings.title: Terms of service link
findings.fix: Link to terms of service or terms and conditions to set the rules for using your site.

findings.title: Cookie consent

findings.title: Analytics installed
findings.fix: Install an analytics tag (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, etc.) so you can measure traffic and behaviour.

findings.message: No Google tag, consent mode not required

findings.fix: If you use Google tags in regulated regions, configure Consent Mode so tracking respects user consent.

findings.title: Author attribution

findings.message: No published or updated date found

findings.title: Outbound citations
findings.fix: Cite authoritative external sources. Outbound links to reputable sites support your claims.

findings.title: About page
findings.fix: Link to an about page that explains who is behind the site. It is a core trust signal.

findings.title: Render-blocking scripts
findings.fix: Add defer or async to scripts in <head>, or move them before </body>, so they do not block rendering.

findings.title: Stylesheet count

findings.title: Cache headers
findings.fix: Send a Cache-Control header so browsers and CDNs can cache responses.

findings.fix: Reduce the raw HTML size. Large documents are slow to parse. Aim under 100KB.

findings.title: Title length

findings.title: Meta description length

findings.title: Viewport meta present

findings.title: Page is indexable

findings.title: Open Graph basics
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image meta tags so the page previews well when shared.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy
findings.fix: Order headings without skipping levels. Do not jump from H2 straight to H4.

findings.title: Word count
findings.fix: Add more substantive content. Thin pages rank poorly. Aim for at least 300 meaningful words.

findings.title: No empty headings
findings.fix: Remove empty heading tags or give them real text.

findings.title: Keyword stuffing
findings.fix: Reduce the repetition of the flagged word and write naturally.

findings.title: Text to HTML ratio

findings.title: HTML lang attribute
findings.fix: Set the language on the root element, e.g. <html lang="en">.

findings.title: Broken internal links

findings.title: Broken external links
findings.fix: Update or remove external links that no longer resolve.

findings.title: Redirect chains
findings.fix: Point the link straight at the final URL so the page loads in one hop.

findings.title: Weak anchor text
findings.fix: Replace generic anchors like 'click here' with text that describes the destination.

findings.title: External link rel
findings.fix: Add rel="noopener" (and noreferrer) to external links, especially those opening new tabs.

findings.title: Image alt text
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image. Use alt="" only for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Image dimensions
findings.fix: Set width and height attributes on images to prevent layout shift.

findings.title: Modern image formats
findings.fix: Serve images as WebP or AVIF for smaller files and faster loads.

findings.title: Lazy loading
findings.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the fold.

findings.title: Image filenames

findings.title: Image src present

findings.title: No empty headings
findings.fix: Remove empty heading tags or give them real text.

findings.title: Keyword stuffing
findings.fix: Reduce the repetition of the flagged word and write naturally.

findings.title: Text to HTML ratio
findings.fix: Increase real text relative to markup, or trim bloated HTML.

findings.title: HTML lang attribute
findings.fix: Set the language on the root element, e.g. <html lang="en">.

findings.title: Broken internal links
findings.fix: Fix or remove the linked internal URLs that return errors.

findings.title: Broken external links
findings.fix: Update or remove external links that no longer resolve.

findings.title: Redirect chains
findings.fix: Point the link straight at the final URL so the page loads in one hop.

findings.title: Weak anchor text
findings.fix: Replace generic anchors like 'click here' with text that describes the destination.

findings.title: External link rel
findings.fix: Add rel="noopener" (and noreferrer) to external links, especially those opening new tabs.

findings.title: Image alt text
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image. Use alt="" only for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Image dimensions
findings.fix: Set width and height attributes on images to prevent layout shift.

findings.title: Modern image formats
findings.fix: Serve images as WebP or AVIF for smaller files and faster loads.

findings.title: Lazy loading
findings.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the fold.

findings.title: Image filenames
findings.fix: Rename images to descriptive, keyword-relevant filenames instead of IMG_1234.jpg.

findings.title: Image src present
findings.fix: Give every a valid src, or remove the tag.

findings.title: Organization or WebSite schema
findings.fix: Add Organization or WebSite JSON-LD so search engines understand the site entity and can show a knowledge panel.

findings.title: JSON-LD @context
findings.fix: Each JSON-LD block should declare "@context": "https://schema.org".

findings.title: Organization sameAs links
findings.fix: Add a sameAs array to your Organization schema linking to your official social and profile URLs. It strengthens entity recognition.

findings.title: Organization logo
findings.fix: Add a logo property to your Organization schema so Google can use it in search features.

findings.title: Article required fields
findings.fix: Article schema needs headline, image, datePublished, and author for rich results. Add the missing fields.

findings.title: Article schema has image
findings.fix: Article and NewsArticle schema should include an image property for rich results.

findings.title: JSON-LD present
findings.fix: Add JSON-LD structured data describing the page, e.g. Article, Product, or Organization.

findings.title: JSON-LD parses
findings.fix: Fix the JSON syntax in the flagged ld+json blocks so they parse cleanly.

findings.title: JSON-LD has @type
findings.fix: Include an @type in each JSON-LD block so search engines know what it describes.

findings.title: Breadcrumb schema
findings.fix: Add BreadcrumbList structured data to show the page's position in the site.

findings.title: Duplicate JSON-LD types
findings.fix: Merge or remove duplicate schema blocks of the same @type.

findings.message: Server header does not leak a version
findings.title: Server header disclosure
findings.fix: Remove or genericise the Server header so it does not reveal software and version.

findings.title: X-Powered-By disclosure
findings.fix: Remove the X-Powered-By header. It discloses your stack and helps attackers.

findings.message: No cookies set on this response
findings.title: Secure cookies
findings.fix: Set Secure and HttpOnly on cookies so they are not sent over HTTP or read by scripts.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
findings.fix: Add Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin to isolate your browsing context.

findings.title: Served over HTTPS
findings.fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

findings.title: HSTS header
findings.fix: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS on future visits.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header to limit what scripts and resources can load.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection
findings.fix: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or a CSP frame-ancestors directive to block clickjacking.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.fix: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to stop MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Referrer-Policy header, e.g. strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Mixed content
findings.fix: Load every resource over HTTPS. Replace any http:// references with https://.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict powerful browser features the site does not use.

findings.title: robots.txt exists
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt at the site root to guide crawlers.

findings.title: robots.txt valid
findings.fix: Add valid directives (User-agent, Disallow, Allow, Sitemap) to robots.txt.

findings.title: Sitemap present
findings.fix: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.title: Page indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the page meta or its X-Robots-Tag header if it should be indexed.

findings.title: Canonical valid
findings.fix: Use an absolute, valid URL in the canonical link.

findings.title: X-Robots-Tag header
findings.fix: Remove noindex or nofollow from the X-Robots-Tag header if the page should rank.

findings.title: Lowercase URL
findings.fix: Use lowercase URLs. Mixed case creates duplicate-URL issues because servers often treat cases differently.

findings.title: Hyphens not underscores
findings.fix: Separate words with hyphens, not underscores. Google treats hyphens as word separators and underscores as joiners.

findings.title: No spaces in URL
findings.fix: Remove spaces from URLs. Replace them with hyphens. Encoded spaces (%20) are hard to read and share.

findings.message: URL uses ASCII or encoded characters
findings.title: ASCII or encoded characters
findings.fix: Percent-encode non-ASCII characters in URLs so every client handles them the same way.

findings.title: Few query parameters
findings.fix: Minimise query parameters. Many parameters multiply crawlable URLs and dilute ranking signals. Aim for two or fewer.

findings.title: Readable, word-based path
findings.fix: Use descriptive words in URLs instead of bare IDs. /products/leather-wallet beats /p?id=42.

findings.title: URL length
findings.fix: Keep URLs short. Long URLs are harder to share and can be truncated in search results. Aim under 100 characters.

findings.title: Shallow path depth
findings.fix: Avoid deep nesting. Keep important pages within a few clicks of the root. Aim for four path segments or fewer.

findings.title: Twitter Card
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> so links preview well on X/Twitter.

findings.title: Open Graph image is absolute
findings.fix: og:image must be an absolute https URL. Social platforms cannot resolve relative paths.

findings.message: og:url or canonical absent, nothing to compare
findings.title: og:url matches canonical
findings.fix: Set og:url to the page's canonical URL so shares consolidate to one address.

findings.title: Social profile links
findings.fix: Link to your social profiles so visitors and search engines can connect your brand accounts.

findings.message: No hreflang alternates (fine for a single-language site)
findings.title: hreflang annotations
findings.fix: If the site serves more than one language or region, add hreflang link alternates so Google serves the right version.

findings.title: hreflang values valid
findings.fix: Use valid hreflang values: a language code, language-REGION (en-US), or x-default. Include a self-referencing and an x-default tag.

findings.title: Privacy policy link
findings.fix: Link to a privacy policy. Most jurisdictions require one if you collect any personal data.

findings.message: No terms of service link found
findings.title: Terms of service link
findings.fix: Link to terms of service or terms and conditions to set the rules for using your site.

findings.title: Cookie consent
findings.fix: If you set non-essential cookies, show a consent banner (a CMP) to comply with privacy law.

findings.title: Contact information
findings.fix: Provide a contact link or page. It builds trust and is a positive E-E-A-T signal.

findings.title: Analytics installed
findings.fix: Install an analytics tag (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, etc.) so you can measure traffic and behaviour.

findings.message: No Google tag, consent mode not required
findings.title: Consent mode
findings.fix: If you use Google tags in regulated regions, configure Consent Mode so tracking respects user consent.

findings.title: Author attribution
findings.fix: Attribute content to a named author via a byline, rel=author, or schema author property.

findings.message: No published or updated date found
findings.title: Published or updated date
findings.fix: Show a published or last-updated date. Freshness and transparency are trust signals.

findings.title: Outbound citations
findings.fix: Cite authoritative external sources. Outbound links to reputable sites support your claims.

findings.title: About page
findings.fix: Link to an about page that explains who is behind the site. It is a core trust signal.

findings.title: Render-blocking scripts
findings.fix: Add defer or async to scripts in <head>, or move them before </body>, so they do not block rendering.

findings.title: Stylesheet count
findings.fix: Combine stylesheets. Many separate CSS files add round trips. Aim for a handful.

findings.title: Inline script size
findings.fix: Move large inline scripts to cacheable external files.

findings.title: Text compression
findings.fix: Enable gzip or Brotli compression on HTML, CSS, and JS responses to cut transfer size.

findings.title: Cache headers
findings.fix: Send a Cache-Control header so browsers and CDNs can cache responses.

findings.title: HTML document size
findings.fix: Reduce the raw HTML size. Large documents are slow to parse. Aim under 100KB.

findings.title: Title tag present
findings.fix: Add a unique <title> in <head> that summarises the page in 30 to 60 characters.

findings.title: Title length
findings.fix: Rewrite the title to sit between 30 and 60 characters so it is not truncated in search results.

findings.title: Meta description present
findings.fix: Add a <meta name="description"> with a 70 to 160 character summary of the page.

findings.title: Meta description length
findings.fix: Trim or expand the meta description to 70 to 160 characters.

findings.title: Exactly one H1
findings.fix: Use exactly one <h1> as the page's main heading. Demote the extras to <h2> or below.

findings.title: H1 length
findings.fix: Rewrite the H1 to sit between 10 and 70 characters. One word says nothing; a sentence is not a heading.

findings.title: Canonical URL present
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing to the preferred absolute URL of this page.

findings.title: Charset declared
findings.fix: Add <meta charset="utf-8"> as the first tag in <head>.

findings.title: Viewport meta present
findings.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> for mobile rendering.

findings.title: Page is indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the robots meta tag if this page should appear in search.

findings.title: Open Graph basics
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image meta tags so the page previews well when shared.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy
findings.fix: Order headings without skipping levels. Do not jump from H2 straight to H4.

findings.title: Word count
findings.fix: Add more substantive content. Thin pages rank poorly. Aim for at least 300 meaningful words.

findings.title: No empty headings
findings.fix: Remove empty heading tags or give them real text.

findings.title: Keyword stuffing
findings.fix: Reduce the repetition of the flagged word and write naturally.

findings.title: Text to HTML ratio
findings.fix: Increase real text relative to markup, or trim bloated HTML.

findings.title: HTML lang attribute
findings.fix: Set the language on the root element, e.g. <html lang="en">.

findings.title: Broken internal links
findings.fix: Fix or remove the linked internal URLs that return errors.

findings.title: Broken external links
findings.fix: Update or remove external links that no longer resolve.

findings.title: Redirect chains
findings.fix: Point the link straight at the final URL so the page loads in one hop.

findings.title: Weak anchor text
findings.fix: Replace generic anchors like 'click here' with text that describes the destination.

findings.title: External link rel
findings.fix: Add rel="noopener" (and noreferrer) to external links, especially those opening new tabs.

findings.title: Image alt text
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image. Use alt="" only for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Image dimensions
findings.fix: Set width and height attributes on images to prevent layout shift.

findings.title: Modern image formats
findings.fix: Serve images as WebP or AVIF for smaller files and faster loads.

findings.title: Lazy loading
findings.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the fold.

findings.title: Image filenames
findings.fix: Rename images to descriptive, keyword-relevant filenames instead of IMG_1234.jpg.

findings.title: Image src present
findings.fix: Give every a valid src, or remove the tag.

findings.title: Organization or WebSite schema

findings.title: JSON-LD @context
findings.fix: Each JSON-LD block should declare "@context": "https://schema.org".

findings.title: Organization sameAs links
findings.fix: Add a sameAs array to your Organization schema linking to your official social and profile URLs. It strengthens entity recognition.

findings.title: Organization logo
findings.fix: Add a logo property to your Organization schema so Google can use it in search features.

findings.title: Article schema has image
findings.fix: Article and NewsArticle schema should include an image property for rich results.

findings.title: JSON-LD parses

findings.title: JSON-LD has @type

findings.title: Breadcrumb schema

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy

findings.title: HSTS header

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy

findings.title: Clickjacking protection

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options

findings.title: Referrer-Policy

findings.title: Permissions-Policy

findings.title: Canonical valid

findings.title: X-Robots-Tag header
findings.fix: Remove noindex or nofollow from the X-Robots-Tag header if the page should rank.

findings.title: Lowercase URL
findings.fix: Use lowercase URLs. Mixed case creates duplicate-URL issues because servers often treat cases differently.

findings.title: Hyphens not underscores
findings.fix: Separate words with hyphens, not underscores. Google treats hyphens as word separators and underscores as joiners.

findings.title: No spaces in URL
findings.fix: Remove spaces from URLs. Replace them with hyphens. Encoded spaces (%20) are hard to read and share.

findings.message: URL uses ASCII or encoded characters
findings.title: ASCII or encoded characters
findings.fix: Percent-encode non-ASCII characters in URLs so every client handles them the same way.

findings.title: Few query parameters
findings.fix: Minimise query parameters. Many parameters multiply crawlable URLs and dilute ranking signals. Aim for two or fewer.

findings.title: Readable, word-based path

findings.title: URL length
findings.fix: Keep URLs short. Long URLs are harder to share and can be truncated in search results. Aim under 100 characters.

findings.title: Shallow path depth
findings.fix: Avoid deep nesting. Keep important pages within a few clicks of the root. Aim for four path segments or fewer.

findings.title: Twitter Card
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> so links preview well on X/Twitter.

findings.title: Open Graph image is absolute

findings.title: Privacy policy link

findings.title: Organization or WebSite schema
findings.fix: Add Organization or WebSite JSON-LD so search engines understand the site entity and can show a knowledge panel.

findings.title: JSON-LD @context
findings.fix: Each JSON-LD block should declare "@context": "https://schema.org".

findings.title: Organization sameAs links
findings.fix: Add a sameAs array to your Organization schema linking to your official social and profile URLs. It strengthens entity recognition.

findings.title: Organization logo
findings.fix: Add a logo property to your Organization schema so Google can use it in search features.

findings.title: Article required fields
findings.fix: Article schema needs headline, image, datePublished, and author for rich results. Add the missing fields.

findings.title: Article schema has image
findings.fix: Article and NewsArticle schema should include an image property for rich results.

findings.title: JSON-LD present
findings.fix: Add JSON-LD structured data describing the page, e.g. Article, Product, or Organization.

findings.title: JSON-LD parses
findings.fix: Fix the JSON syntax in the flagged ld+json blocks so they parse cleanly.

findings.title: JSON-LD has @type
findings.fix: Include an @type in each JSON-LD block so search engines know what it describes.

findings.title: Breadcrumb schema
findings.fix: Add BreadcrumbList structured data to show the page's position in the site.

findings.title: Duplicate JSON-LD types
findings.fix: Merge or remove duplicate schema blocks of the same @type.

findings.message: Server header does not leak a version
findings.title: Server header disclosure
findings.fix: Remove or genericise the Server header so it does not reveal software and version.

findings.title: X-Powered-By disclosure
findings.fix: Remove the X-Powered-By header. It discloses your stack and helps attackers.

findings.message: No cookies set on this response
findings.title: Secure cookies
findings.fix: Set Secure and HttpOnly on cookies so they are not sent over HTTP or read by scripts.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
findings.fix: Add Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin to isolate your browsing context.

findings.title: Served over HTTPS
findings.fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

findings.title: HSTS header
findings.fix: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS on future visits.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header to limit what scripts and resources can load.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection
findings.fix: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or a CSP frame-ancestors directive to block clickjacking.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.fix: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to stop MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Referrer-Policy header, e.g. strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Mixed content
findings.fix: Load every resource over HTTPS. Replace any http:// references with https://.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict powerful browser features the site does not use.

findings.title: robots.txt exists
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt at the site root to guide crawlers.

findings.title: robots.txt valid
findings.fix: Add valid directives (User-agent, Disallow, Allow, Sitemap) to robots.txt.

findings.title: Sitemap present
findings.fix: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.title: Page indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the page meta or its X-Robots-Tag header if it should be indexed.

findings.title: Canonical valid
findings.fix: Use an absolute, valid URL in the canonical link.

findings.title: X-Robots-Tag header
findings.fix: Remove noindex or nofollow from the X-Robots-Tag header if the page should rank.

findings.title: Lowercase URL
findings.fix: Use lowercase URLs. Mixed case creates duplicate-URL issues because servers often treat cases differently.

findings.title: Hyphens not underscores
findings.fix: Separate words with hyphens, not underscores. Google treats hyphens as word separators and underscores as joiners.

findings.title: No spaces in URL
findings.fix: Remove spaces from URLs. Replace them with hyphens. Encoded spaces (%20) are hard to read and share.

findings.message: URL uses ASCII or encoded characters
findings.title: ASCII or encoded characters
findings.fix: Percent-encode non-ASCII characters in URLs so every client handles them the same way.

findings.title: Few query parameters
findings.fix: Minimise query parameters. Many parameters multiply crawlable URLs and dilute ranking signals. Aim for two or fewer.

findings.title: Readable, word-based path
findings.fix: Use descriptive words in URLs instead of bare IDs. /products/leather-wallet beats /p?id=42.

findings.title: URL length
findings.fix: Keep URLs short. Long URLs are harder to share and can be truncated in search results. Aim under 100 characters.

findings.title: Shallow path depth
findings.fix: Avoid deep nesting. Keep important pages within a few clicks of the root. Aim for four path segments or fewer.

findings.title: Twitter Card
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> so links preview well on X/Twitter.

findings.title: Open Graph image is absolute
findings.fix: og:image must be an absolute https URL. Social platforms cannot resolve relative paths.

findings.message: og:url or canonical absent, nothing to compare
findings.title: og:url matches canonical
findings.fix: Set og:url to the page's canonical URL so shares consolidate to one address.

findings.title: Social profile links
findings.fix: Link to your social profiles so visitors and search engines can connect your brand accounts.

findings.message: No hreflang alternates (fine for a single-language site)
findings.title: hreflang annotations
findings.fix: If the site serves more than one language or region, add hreflang link alternates so Google serves the right version.

findings.title: hreflang values valid
findings.fix: Use valid hreflang values: a language code, language-REGION (en-US), or x-default. Include a self-referencing and an x-default tag.

findings.title: Privacy policy link
findings.fix: Link to a privacy policy. Most jurisdictions require one if you collect any personal data.

findings.message: No terms of service link found
findings.title: Terms of service link
findings.fix: Link to terms of service or terms and conditions to set the rules for using your site.

findings.title: Cookie consent
findings.fix: If you set non-essential cookies, show a consent banner (a CMP) to comply with privacy law.

findings.title: Contact information
findings.fix: Provide a contact link or page. It builds trust and is a positive E-E-A-T signal.

findings.title: Analytics installed
findings.fix: Install an analytics tag (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, etc.) so you can measure traffic and behaviour.

findings.message: No Google tag, consent mode not required
findings.title: Consent mode
findings.fix: If you use Google tags in regulated regions, configure Consent Mode so tracking respects user consent.

findings.title: Author attribution
findings.fix: Attribute content to a named author via a byline, rel=author, or schema author property.

findings.message: No published or updated date found
findings.title: Published or updated date
findings.fix: Show a published or last-updated date. Freshness and transparency are trust signals.

findings.title: Outbound citations
findings.fix: Cite authoritative external sources. Outbound links to reputable sites support your claims.

findings.title: About page
findings.fix: Link to an about page that explains who is behind the site. It is a core trust signal.

findings.title: Render-blocking scripts
findings.fix: Add defer or async to scripts in <head>, or move them before </body>, so they do not block rendering.

findings.title: Stylesheet count
findings.fix: Combine stylesheets. Many separate CSS files add round trips. Aim for a handful.

findings.title: Inline script size
findings.fix: Move large inline scripts to cacheable external files.

findings.title: Text compression
findings.fix: Enable gzip or Brotli compression on HTML, CSS, and JS responses to cut transfer size.

findings.title: Cache headers
findings.fix: Send a Cache-Control header so browsers and CDNs can cache responses.

findings.title: HTML document size
findings.fix: Reduce the raw HTML size. Large documents are slow to parse. Aim under 100KB.

findings.title: Meta description present
findings.fix: Add a <meta name="description"> with a 70 to 160 character summary of the page.

findings.title: Meta description length
findings.fix: Trim or expand the meta description to 70 to 160 characters.

findings.title: Exactly one H1
findings.fix: Use exactly one <h1> as the page's main heading. Demote the extras to <h2> or below.

findings.title: H1 length
findings.fix: Rewrite the H1 to sit between 10 and 70 characters. One word says nothing; a sentence is not a heading.

findings.title: Canonical URL present
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing to the preferred absolute URL of this page.

findings.title: Charset declared
findings.fix: Add <meta charset="utf-8"> as the first tag in <head>.

findings.title: Viewport meta present
findings.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> for mobile rendering.

findings.title: Page is indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the robots meta tag if this page should appear in search.

findings.title: Open Graph basics
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image meta tags so the page previews well when shared.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy
findings.fix: Order headings without skipping levels. Do not jump from H2 straight to H4.

findings.title: Word count
findings.fix: Add more substantive content. Thin pages rank poorly. Aim for at least 300 meaningful words.

findings.title: No empty headings
findings.fix: Remove empty heading tags or give them real text.

findings.title: Keyword stuffing
findings.fix: Reduce the repetition of the flagged word and write naturally.

findings.title: Text to HTML ratio
findings.fix: Increase real text relative to markup, or trim bloated HTML.

findings.title: HTML lang attribute
findings.fix: Set the language on the root element, e.g. <html lang="en">.

findings.title: Broken internal links
findings.fix: Fix or remove the linked internal URLs that return errors.

findings.title: Broken external links
findings.fix: Update or remove external links that no longer resolve.

findings.title: Redirect chains
findings.fix: Point the link straight at the final URL so the page loads in one hop.

findings.title: Weak anchor text
findings.fix: Replace generic anchors like 'click here' with text that describes the destination.

findings.title: External link rel
findings.fix: Add rel="noopener" (and noreferrer) to external links, especially those opening new tabs.

findings.title: Image alt text
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image. Use alt="" only for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Image dimensions
findings.fix: Set width and height attributes on images to prevent layout shift.

findings.title: Modern image formats
findings.fix: Serve images as WebP or AVIF for smaller files and faster loads.

findings.title: Lazy loading
findings.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the fold.

findings.title: Image filenames
findings.fix: Rename images to descriptive, keyword-relevant filenames instead of IMG_1234.jpg.

findings.title: Image src present
findings.fix: Give every a valid src, or remove the tag.

findings.title: Organization or WebSite schema
findings.fix: Add Organization or WebSite JSON-LD so search engines understand the site entity and can show a knowledge panel.

findings.title: JSON-LD @context
findings.fix: Each JSON-LD block should declare "@context": "https://schema.org".

findings.title: Organization sameAs links
findings.fix: Add a sameAs array to your Organization schema linking to your official social and profile URLs. It strengthens entity recognition.

findings.title: Organization logo
findings.fix: Add a logo property to your Organization schema so Google can use it in search features.

findings.title: Article required fields
findings.fix: Article schema needs headline, image, datePublished, and author for rich results. Add the missing fields.

findings.title: Article schema has image
findings.fix: Article and NewsArticle schema should include an image property for rich results.

findings.title: JSON-LD present
findings.fix: Add JSON-LD structured data describing the page, e.g. Article, Product, or Organization.

findings.title: JSON-LD parses
findings.fix: Fix the JSON syntax in the flagged ld+json blocks so they parse cleanly.

findings.title: JSON-LD has @type
findings.fix: Include an @type in each JSON-LD block so search engines know what it describes.

findings.title: Breadcrumb schema
findings.fix: Add BreadcrumbList structured data to show the page's position in the site.

findings.title: Duplicate JSON-LD types
findings.fix: Merge or remove duplicate schema blocks of the same @type.

findings.message: Server header does not leak a version
findings.title: Server header disclosure
findings.fix: Remove or genericise the Server header so it does not reveal software and version.

findings.title: X-Powered-By disclosure
findings.fix: Remove the X-Powered-By header. It discloses your stack and helps attackers.

findings.message: No cookies set on this response
findings.title: Secure cookies
findings.fix: Set Secure and HttpOnly on cookies so they are not sent over HTTP or read by scripts.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
findings.fix: Add Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin to isolate your browsing context.

findings.title: Served over HTTPS
findings.fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

findings.title: HSTS header
findings.fix: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS on future visits.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header to limit what scripts and resources can load.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection
findings.fix: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or a CSP frame-ancestors directive to block clickjacking.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.fix: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to stop MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Referrer-Policy header, e.g. strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Mixed content
findings.fix: Load every resource over HTTPS. Replace any http:// references with https://.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict powerful browser features the site does not use.

findings.title: robots.txt exists
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt at the site root to guide crawlers.

findings.title: robots.txt valid
findings.fix: Add valid directives (User-agent, Disallow, Allow, Sitemap) to robots.txt.

findings.title: Sitemap present
findings.fix: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.title: Page indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the page meta or its X-Robots-Tag header if it should be indexed.

findings.title: Canonical valid
findings.fix: Use an absolute, valid URL in the canonical link.

findings.title: X-Robots-Tag header
findings.fix: Remove noindex or nofollow from the X-Robots-Tag header if the page should rank.

findings.title: Lowercase URL
findings.fix: Use lowercase URLs. Mixed case creates duplicate-URL issues because servers often treat cases differently.

findings.title: Hyphens not underscores
findings.fix: Separate words with hyphens, not underscores. Google treats hyphens as word separators and underscores as joiners.

findings.title: No spaces in URL
findings.fix: Remove spaces from URLs. Replace them with hyphens. Encoded spaces (%20) are hard to read and share.

findings.message: URL uses ASCII or encoded characters
findings.title: ASCII or encoded characters
findings.fix: Percent-encode non-ASCII characters in URLs so every client handles them the same way.

findings.title: Few query parameters
findings.fix: Minimise query parameters. Many parameters multiply crawlable URLs and dilute ranking signals. Aim for two or fewer.

findings.title: Readable, word-based path
findings.fix: Use descriptive words in URLs instead of bare IDs. /products/leather-wallet beats /p?id=42.

findings.title: URL length
findings.fix: Keep URLs short. Long URLs are harder to share and can be truncated in search results. Aim under 100 characters.

findings.title: Shallow path depth
findings.fix: Avoid deep nesting. Keep important pages within a few clicks of the root. Aim for four path segments or fewer.

findings.title: Twitter Card
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> so links preview well on X/Twitter.

findings.title: Open Graph image is absolute
findings.fix: og:image must be an absolute https URL. Social platforms cannot resolve relative paths.

findings.message: og:url or canonical absent, nothing to compare
findings.title: og:url matches canonical
findings.fix: Set og:url to the page's canonical URL so shares consolidate to one address.

findings.title: Social profile links
findings.fix: Link to your social profiles so visitors and search engines can connect your brand accounts.

findings.message: No hreflang alternates (fine for a single-language site)
findings.title: hreflang annotations
findings.fix: If the site serves more than one language or region, add hreflang link alternates so Google serves the right version.

findings.title: hreflang values valid
findings.fix: Use valid hreflang values: a language code, language-REGION (en-US), or x-default. Include a self-referencing and an x-default tag.

findings.title: Privacy policy link
findings.fix: Link to a privacy policy. Most jurisdictions require one if you collect any personal data.

findings.message: No terms of service link found
findings.title: Terms of service link
findings.fix: Link to terms of service or terms and conditions to set the rules for using your site.

findings.title: Cookie consent
findings.fix: If you set non-essential cookies, show a consent banner (a CMP) to comply with privacy law.

findings.title: Contact information
findings.fix: Provide a contact link or page. It builds trust and is a positive E-E-A-T signal.

findings.title: Analytics installed
findings.fix: Install an analytics tag (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, etc.) so you can measure traffic and behaviour.

findings.message: No Google tag, consent mode not required
findings.title: Consent mode
findings.fix: If you use Google tags in regulated regions, configure Consent Mode so tracking respects user consent.

findings.title: Author attribution
findings.fix: Attribute content to a named author via a byline, rel=author, or schema author property.

findings.message: No published or updated date found
findings.title: Published or updated date
findings.fix: Show a published or last-updated date. Freshness and transparency are trust signals.

findings.title: Outbound citations
findings.fix: Cite authoritative external sources. Outbound links to reputable sites support your claims.

findings.title: About page
findings.fix: Link to an about page that explains who is behind the site. It is a core trust signal.

findings.title: Render-blocking scripts
findings.fix: Add defer or async to scripts in <head>, or move them before </body>, so they do not block rendering.

findings.title: Stylesheet count
findings.fix: Combine stylesheets. Many separate CSS files add round trips. Aim for a handful.

findings.title: Inline script size
findings.fix: Move large inline scripts to cacheable external files.

findings.title: Text compression
findings.fix: Enable gzip or Brotli compression on HTML, CSS, and JS responses to cut transfer size.

findings.title: Cache headers
findings.fix: Send a Cache-Control header so browsers and CDNs can cache responses.

findings.title: HTML document size
findings.fix: Reduce the raw HTML size. Large documents are slow to parse. Aim under 100KB.

findings.fix: Set Secure and HttpOnly on cookies so they are not sent over HTTP or read by scripts.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
findings.fix: Add Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin to isolate your browsing context.

findings.title: Served over HTTPS
findings.fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

findings.title: HSTS header
findings.fix: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS on future visits.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header to limit what scripts and resources can load.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection
findings.fix: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or a CSP frame-ancestors directive to block clickjacking.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.fix: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to stop MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Referrer-Policy header, e.g. strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Mixed content
findings.fix: Load every resource over HTTPS. Replace any http:// references with https://.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.fix: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict powerful browser features the site does not use.

findings.title: robots.txt exists
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt at the site root to guide crawlers.

findings.title: robots.txt valid
findings.fix: Add valid directives (User-agent, Disallow, Allow, Sitemap) to robots.txt.

findings.title: Sitemap present
findings.fix: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.title: Page indexable
findings.fix: Remove noindex from the page meta or its X-Robots-Tag header if it should be indexed.

findings.title: Canonical valid
findings.fix: Use an absolute, valid URL in the canonical link.

findings.title: X-Robots-Tag header
findings.fix: Remove noindex or nofollow from the X-Robots-Tag header if the page should rank.

findings.title: Lowercase URL
findings.fix: Use lowercase URLs. Mixed case creates duplicate-URL issues because servers often treat cases differently.

findings.title: Hyphens not underscores
findings.fix: Separate words with hyphens, not underscores. Google treats hyphens as word separators and underscores as joiners.

findings.title: No spaces in URL
findings.fix: Remove spaces from URLs. Replace them with hyphens. Encoded spaces (%20) are hard to read and share.

findings.message: URL uses ASCII or encoded characters
findings.title: ASCII or encoded characters
findings.fix: Percent-encode non-ASCII characters in URLs so every client handles them the same way.

findings.title: Few query parameters
findings.fix: Minimise query parameters. Many parameters multiply crawlable URLs and dilute ranking signals. Aim for two or fewer.

findings.title: Readable, word-based path
findings.fix: Use descriptive words in URLs instead of bare IDs. /products/leather-wallet beats /p?id=42.

findings.title: URL length
findings.fix: Keep URLs short. Long URLs are harder to share and can be truncated in search results. Aim under 100 characters.

findings.title: Shallow path depth
findings.fix: Avoid deep nesting. Keep important pages within a few clicks of the root. Aim for four path segments or fewer.

findings.title: Twitter Card
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> so links preview well on X/Twitter.

findings.title: Open Graph image is absolute
findings.fix: og:image must be an absolute https URL. Social platforms cannot resolve relative paths.

findings.message: og:url or canonical absent, nothing to compare
findings.title: og:url matches canonical
findings.fix: Set og:url to the page's canonical URL so shares consolidate to one address.

findings.title: Social profile links
findings.fix: Link to your social profiles so visitors and search engines can connect your brand accounts.

findings.message: No hreflang alternates (fine for a single-language site)
findings.title: hreflang annotations
findings.fix: If the site serves more than one language or region, add hreflang link alternates so Google serves the right version.

findings.title: hreflang values valid
findings.fix: Use valid hreflang values: a language code, language-REGION (en-US), or x-default. Include a self-referencing and an x-default tag.

findings.title: Privacy policy link
findings.fix: Link to a privacy policy. Most jurisdictions require one if you collect any personal data.

findings.message: No terms of service link found
findings.title: Terms of service link
findings.fix: Link to terms of service or terms and conditions to set the rules for using your site.

findings.title: Cookie consent
findings.fix: If you set non-essential cookies, show a consent banner (a CMP) to comply with privacy law.

findings.title: Contact information
findings.fix: Provide a contact link or page. It builds trust and is a positive E-E-A-T signal.

findings.title: Analytics installed
findings.fix: Install an analytics tag (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, etc.) so you can measure traffic and behaviour.

findings.message: No Google tag, consent mode not required
findings.title: Consent mode
findings.fix: If you use Google tags in regulated regions, configure Consent Mode so tracking respects user consent.

findings.title: Author attribution
findings.fix: Attribute content to a named author via a byline, rel=author, or schema author property.

findings.message: No published or updated date found
findings.title: Published or updated date
findings.fix: Show a published or last-updated date. Freshness and transparency are trust signals.

findings.title: Outbound citations
findings.fix: Cite authoritative external sources. Outbound links to reputable sites support your claims.

findings.title: About page
findings.fix: Link to an about page that explains who is behind the site. It is a core trust signal.

findings.title: Render-blocking scripts
findings.fix: Add defer or async to scripts in <head>, or move them before </body>, so they do not block rendering.

findings.title: Stylesheet count
findings.fix: Combine stylesheets. Many separate CSS files add round trips. Aim for a handful.

findings.title: Inline script size
findings.fix: Move large inline scripts to cacheable external files.

findings.title: Text compression
findings.fix: Enable gzip or Brotli compression on HTML, CSS, and JS responses to cut transfer size.

findings.title: Cache headers
findings.fix: Send a Cache-Control header so browsers and CDNs can cache responses.

findings.title: HTML document size
findings.fix: Reduce the raw HTML size. Large documents are slow to parse. Aim under 100KB.
